title: RVALID Asserted Without Corresponding Read Request
description: The crossbar spontaneously asserts RVALID with stale RDATA from a previous transaction when no ARVALID has been seen.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [AXI_PROT_CHECK] RVALID high with no pending ARVALID transaction
expected_root_cause: The read pipeline state machine transitions to the RVALID state on a combinational signal that glitches without a valid AR-channel handshake [11].
failure_log:
T=50: ARVALID=0, RVALID=1, RDATA=0xDEAD. No request pending.
UVM_ERROR: Spurious read response.
success_log: RVALID asserted only after AR-channel handshake registers an outstanding read.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (!rst_n) rvalid <= 0; else if (ar_done) rvalid <= 1; else if (rvalid && rready) rvalid <= 0;
